## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or missing workflow? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include proposed CLI command syntax or JSON response shape if applicable.

## Architectural Considerations
- Does this change adhere to the **zero runtime dependencies** principle?
- Does it maintain SQLite ACID invariants and deterministic write boundaries?
- How does an AI agent interact with this feature?

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or agent workflow examples here.
